Name: Enchanted Garden Buildings
Author: naeldeus
Description:
ali gave me permission to convert and make her mods seasonal, so here is a conversion for now. please enjoy!

[b][size=4]features:[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*]a content packer version for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/641]enchanted garden buildings[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34430155]ali[/url]﻿
[*]you can choose between ali's original shed and a new alternative design
[/list]
[b][size=4]installation:
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]download and install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
[*]drop the content of this zip file in your Mods[i] [/i]folder
[*]edit the config file if you wish to use the alternate shed, change [i]OriginalShed [/i]to [i]AltShed[/i]
[*]that's it, have fun!
[/list]
[b][size=4]credits:[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]ali for her original buildings
[/list][size=4]
